description: The Reserve Bank of Australia publishes quarterly operational reliability figures for its payment settlement services in the Reserve Bank Information and Transfer System (RITS). Tables give the percentage availability of RITS overall and of its settlement services for cash transfers, SWIFT real-time gross settlement of high-value payments, Austraclear securities settlements, batch feeders (property, CHESS, eftpos and Mastercard batches) and the low-value settlement service, as well as the Fast Settlement Service for the New Payments Platform and the Low Value Clearing Service. In the March quarter of 2026, RITS availability was 99.560 per cent, with batch feeders the lowest at 98.718. Availability is the time without an outage as a share of each system's core operating hours, and recent quarters may be revised. Access is free as web tables for each year, and the page links to documentation of availability targets. No licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: figures are quarterly aggregates without outage start times or causes. For simulation it gives measured availability of a national settlement system, useful to calibrate outage frequency in financial infrastructure reliability and cascading-failure models. Related catalogue records include the RBA retail payments reliability disclosures and Fedwire statistics.
